name: Red Mountain

climate: Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot and Syrah sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.

terms: American Viticultural Area. A wine labeled with one must take at least 85% of its grapes from that area.

notes: Washington wines are known for bright fruit flavors and crisp acidity.
Recent reds lean riper and more fruit-forward, with noticeable tannin, oak and moderately high alcohol.
Cabernet and Merlot are often lush, with concentrated berry flavors such as blackberry, cherry and raspberry.
Good examples can usually age at least eight years.
Cabernet Franc is fruit-forward, with blueberry and raspberry.

blurb.text: Red Mountain's vineyards are planted mostly to red grapes, led by Cabernet Sauvignon at 64 percent, then Merlot and Syrah.
